Dataset gen-notes-b on dev (43c38a4f, live Haiku 4.5), each fixture through the app's UI; checks as in the matrix (re-scored offline with the corrected section reader: same result). 7/10 keep the doubt and the confirmation — below the 9/10 of 3.2: FAILED. A physician's doubt disappears from the note once the diagnosis is confirmed later in the dictation ('I was worried about aspiration' becomes only the confirming swallow study)

Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S13 AI Check 2: the physician's initial doubt survives a later confirmation (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U13 AI Check 2: when the physician voices initial uncertainty about a diagnosis that is confirmed later in the same dictation, the doubt survives in the note rather than being erased. … (UAT TC-14 AI Check 2; UAT 3.2; TFA-92592 AC 9; TFA-94229 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr; TFA-94229 in progress
  • U5 The note reflects only what was dictated or stored, and undictated sections read 'Not dictated'. No supplied diagnosis, invented exam finding or normal, guessed unit on an ambiguous value, 'No past m … (UAT TC-14; UAT 3.4; TFA-92592 AC 5; TFA-94229 R8) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr; TFA-94229 in progress
  • T4 No dictated fact silently disappears from the note (Principle 2). (TFA-94229 R9) — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-14 step 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Ten encounters, 5 Hospital and 5 Nursing Home, where the physician first doubts a diagnosis and the same dictation later confirms it

When Each fixture goes through ai/notes:generateNote with the patient context its mode's client builds

Then The note keeps the alternative or the doubt the physician voiced and also the confirmation; the doubt is not erased

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Per fixture: mustInclude the considered alternative or a doubt word AND the confirmed diagnosis. Where the confirming result could itself name the alternative (H-06, H-09, N-07), sameSentence requires a doubt word in the same sentence as the alternative, and H-09 / N-07 word the confirmation without naming it, so 'MRI negative for stroke' alone cannot pass. …
